shortDescription: Two jailed leaders of India's Cockroach Janta Party are expected to be released Sunday, the party's legal head said, according to Bloomberg. Police barricades and a heavy security presence in New Delhi underscore continuing tensions over a contentious voter-roll revision.

title: India's Cockroach Janta Party Leaders Expected to Be Freed as Protests Spread
